name: Princess Silhouette
desc: Elegant princess silhouette with cape and crown, arms can be raised
code: const s=ctx.scale||1; const x=ctx.x||0; const y=ctx.y||0; const col=ctx.color||'#6A5ACD'; const armsUp=ctx.armsUp||false; const bob=Math.sin(mt*0.5)*0; svg += `<g transform="translate(${x},${y}) scale(${s})">`; const dressColor = isN ? col : '#87CEEB'; const strokeCol = isN ? '#483D8B' : '#5F9EA0'; svg += `<polygon points="0,${-25+bob} -12,${0+bob} 12,${0+bob}" fill="${dressColor}" stroke="${strokeCol}" stroke-width="${ol*0.5}" opacity="0.85"/>`; const capeFlow = Math.sin(mt*1.2)*7; svg += `<path d="M4 ${-22+bob} Q16 ${-16+capeFlow} 12 ${-3+capeFlow*1.5}" fill="none" stroke="${isN?'#9370DB':'#ADD8E6'}" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.65"/>`; svg += `<circle cx="0" cy="${-30+bob}" r="6" fill="#FFDAB9" stroke="#DEB887" stroke-width="${ol*0.3}"/>`; const braidSway = Math.sin(mt*0.9)*3; svg += `<path d="M4 ${-28+bob} Q10 ${-20+braidSway} 8 ${-10+braidSway*1.2}" fill="none" stroke="#F5DEB3" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>`; svg += `<path d="M-5 ${-35+bob} L-3 ${-39+bob} L0 ${-36+bob} L3 ${-39+bob} L5 ${-35+bob}" fill="none" stroke="${sc.acc}" stroke-width="1.5"/>`; if(armsUp){ svg += `<line x1="-10" y1="${-18+bob}" x2="-18" y2="${-36+Math.sin(mt*3)*4+bob}" stroke="#FFDAB9" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>`; svg += `<line x1="10" y1="${-18+bob}" x2="18" y2="${-36+Math.cos(mt*3)*4+bob}" stroke="#FFDAB9" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>`; } else { svg += `<line x1="-10" y1="${-18+bob}" x2="-18" y2="${-10+bob}" stroke="#FFDAB9" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>`; svg += `<line x1="10" y1="${-18+bob}" x2="16" y2="${-8+bob}" stroke="#FFDAB9" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>`; } svg += `</g>`; return svg;
